notes.title: Chapter 10 - Available Now !
notes.notes:
[h1]Chapter 10 - Available Now ![/h1]
[h2]New Mechanism[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stealth Cloak: Upon picking up the Stealth Cloak, the panda becomes invisible to any guards. Stealth mode lasts until any guard is eliminated.
[/list]
[h2]Levels[/h2]
[list]
[*] 10A：20 Levels
[*] 10B：50 Levels
[*] 10C：100+ Random levels
[*] 10D：100+ Random levels
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a guard might erroneously be triggered for elimination on the second turn of the clock
[/list]
[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 5 new achievements for Chapter 10
[/list]

notes.title: Workshop
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are excited to announce that the workshop has been implemented. You can now upload custom levels created in the game to the Workshop, or subscribe to and play levels uploaded by other players. 

We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing the incredible custom content that the community will create.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2626360/workshop/]Learn more[/url]

Best regards,
The Panda Go Development Team
